summary: The document provides configuration and implementation details for a web-based system related to educational guidelines, including controls, data binding, event handling, and UI setup.
purpose: To outline the implementation of the 'Guidelines' web page, providing details about its controls, data sources, event handlers, and interactions.

workflows.name: View Selection Workflow
steps: User selects a view from uxView DropDownList
Depending on chosen value, pnlTopic and pnlSubtopic visibility toggles
Data binds to selected agency or topic

workflows.name: Agency Selection Workflow
steps: User selects agency from uxAgency DropDownList
System defaults to user's agency or binds data
Subtopic list is refreshed through LoadSubtopicList method

business_rules: ScreenIsEditable is true if the user is not in ViewOnly mode and has access via administrative privileges
Certain components are mutually exclusive based on user selection
validations: check if user agency selection matches user's agency ID
check if data is inactive before rendering certain UI components
conditions: If uxView.SelectedValue is '0', pnlTopic is visible and others hidden
If Dropdown.CurrentID(uxAgency) != 0, subtopic items are adjusted
system_behavior: Refreshes the page when popups cause refresh
exceptions: Potential data casting issues if incorrect value formats are used
